name: meetmind-desktop
description: MeetMind desktop app: native audio capture plus the React UI

scripts.start: npm run build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE open -n -a "$(pwd)/node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app" --args "$(pwd)"
scripts.smoke: npm run build && rm -f out/smoke.log && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE open -n -a "$(pwd)/node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app" --args "$(pwd)" --smoke && sleep 66 && cat out/smoke.log
